name: placement_result
description: Private learner placement status, method flags, skill estimates, and responses for one Parle account

user_id.description: Buildy account id for the learner who owns this result

taken_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when the placement was completed or skipped

level_per_skill.description: JSON object serialized as a string, keyed by L, R, W, and S; unassessed or optional skills are null

nclc_estimate_per_skill.description: JSON object serialized as a string with broad framework-range estimates only where supported

skill_state_per_skill.description: JSON object serialized as a string distinguishing assessed, transcript-only, optional, and not-assessed skill states

score_per_skill.description: JSON object serialized as a string with auto-score and writing rubric details

feedback_per_skill.description: JSON object serialized as a string with concise writing feedback

grammar_vocabulary_level.description: Separate grammar and vocabulary diagnostic level; this is not an NCLC skill

grammar_vocabulary_score.description: JSON object serialized as a string with the grammar and vocabulary score

target_per_skill_at_test.description: JSON object serialized as a string snapshot of the learner's targets when this assessment was taken

speaking_assessed.description: Whether speaking was assessed; false while speech transcription is unavailable

responses.description: JSON array serialized as a string containing per-item selections, correctness, writing response, and rubric feedback

status.description: Assessment state; only assessed results count toward the 14-day retake gate

self_assessed_level.description: Learner's self-assessed starting level, stored separately from placement estimates

source.description: How the current starting level was supplied, such as self_assessment or placement_test

track.description: Learner track at the time this result was saved
